name: Suffering & Trials
overview: Scripture reveals that suffering and trials are intrinsic to the human experience, beginning with the consequences of sin as seen in Genesis where conflict and hardship emerge, such as Cain’s violence against Abel and Lot’s distress in Sodom. These passages highlight how adversity often arises from both external opposition and personal struggle. The Bible portrays suffering as a profound reality that tests faith and character, inviting believers to trust God’s sovereign purposes even amid pain and hardship. Through these trials, God’s redemptive work is evident, calling Christians to follow Christ’s example of endurance and to find hope beyond present afflictions.
